text:
Priya: Quick heads-up — during today's preflight the SI flagged a tenant-isolation constraint that blocks the current marketplace image. They need strict per-tenant VPC/NAT separation and no host-level agent that assumes access to host network. :rotating_light:

Carlos (SI): Confirmed. Customer (OceanaHealth) will decline anything that requires shared host networking. Our marketplace installer runs an agent on host network for fast metrics and KV cache warmup — that's the problem.

Evan: Do we have a clear list of what the agent needs network-wise? can we run it in user NS / container net mode instead?

Jules: Short answer: agent needs egress to telemetry.redwood.internal:443, and local unix socket to talk to runtime. We also use hostnet for low-latency shm and to touch /dev/shm.

Aisha: From a security policy POV we can't ask the customer to relax their VPC carveout. We should explore a non-host-net packaging or an alternate sidecar that uses hostPath limited mounts.

Priya: Action: need an architecture decision for the go-live. Can we ship a compatibility image that drops hostnet and falls back to proxied KV? If not, we need an explicit exception from customer or change in runbook.

Evan: I'll prototype a containerized agent that uses TCP loopback + TLS to the runtime process. Should avoid host network but we may lose shm perf. rough patch: config flag `--no-hostnet`.

Jules: Perf impact estimate: token latency up ~10-18% for small batch sizes without shared memory; CPU cost increases on inference host by ~5-8%. Not ideal but acceptable for initial ramp.

Carlos (SI): Customer prefers predictable behavior over micro-latency. They'll accept ~10% if documented. They asked for documented network policy (allowed egress hosts/ports) and a clear rollback plan.

Priya: Ok. Can we draft the network policy and an AMI tag that has the no-hostnet agent? Need ETA for next-week canary.

Evan: ETA: prototype by EOD tomorrow, internal canary by Wednesday if no major blockers. I'll post a short diff and a small config snippet.

sre-bot: deploy-trigger: canary pipeline for `si/oceana-health/no-hostnet-agent` created by Evan at 2945678915.

Aisha: I'll draft the approved network policy text. Minimal egress: `telemetry.redwood.internal:443`, `kv.redwood.internal:8443`, outbound DNS and NTP. No inbound ports. Need to confirm whether healthcheck uses 10256.

Jules: Healthcheck uses local 9876 only. Not exposed externally.

Carlos (SI): I'll coordinate customer sign-off once we have the policy + perf note. Also need a short runbook entry for field eng to revert to hostnet image if something fails.

Priya: Perfect. I'll schedule a 30m sync for tomorrow 9am PT to walk through the policy and rollout plan. Send calendar invite. :thumbsup:

Evan: added — invite sent. Attaching quick config patch in thread: 
```yaml
agent:
  hostNetwork: false
  tls:
    enabled: true
  egress:
    - telemetry.redwood.internal:443
    - kv.redwood.internal:8443
```

Priya: Thanks — keep thread updated with canary results and any perf anomalies.

Carlos (SI): Will do.
